settings.content: Colors are roles, not hues: Primary drives headings, buttons and dark sections; Accent is a sparing highlight; Gold is for hairlines and details. The theme ships two styles, Mézaj (espresso and gold) and Garden (forest green and burgundy). Keep text colors at 4.5:1 or more against Paper and Cream.

settings.label: Primary
settings.info: Headings, primary buttons, the Dark (primary) scheme and the footer.

settings.label: Accent
settings.info: Used sparingly: sale badges, cart count, the Accent scheme.

settings.label: Gold detail
settings.info: Hairlines, the emblem, eyebrow rules and details on dark schemes. Never used for body text on light backgrounds.

settings.label: Labels on light backgrounds
settings.info: Eyebrows, small capitals and focus rings on Paper and Cream. Must reach 4.5:1 against both.

settings.label: Show floating WhatsApp button
settings.info: Uses the WhatsApp number from Social media. Hidden when that is empty.

settings.label: Default message
settings.default: Hello Mézaj, I would like to place an order.

settings.label: Heading font
settings.info: A refined, high-contrast serif suits the Mézaj wordmark.

settings.label: Instagram URL
settings.info: Also used by the Instagram grid section.

settings.label: WhatsApp number or link
settings.info: A number such as +961 70 123 456 becomes a wa.me link. Anything else is used as a link.
